test_quality_notes: Every fix landed with a failing test first or a rewritten assertion; no suite was skipped or weakened.
The drag fix is asserted with an elementFromPoint hit-test because Playwright dragTo synthesizes drags without hit-testing, which would false-pass a non-draggable source.
The stale-summary test uses waitFor because the assertion ran before the state flush in an earlier attempt.
